welcome.title: Waslah
welcome.line1: Rides and deliveries in your city, from inside Telegram — no app to install.
welcome.line2: You pick your destination and get an estimate from a real route — and when we cannot compute one we say «unavailable» rather than guess.
welcome.line3: Before we start: read the terms and the privacy policy and accept them. The time you accept is recorded.
welcome.language_note: Language changes this screen's text now. Saving it to your account is item F2-11 — we do not claim it is saved today.
welcome.consent_required_hint: Both are required, and each is recorded separately with its own timestamp.
welcome.consent_superseded: The document changed after your earlier consent, so we ask again.
welcome.location_note: We do not ask for location permission on this screen. We ask at the moment it is needed, when you set a destination.
welcome.after_consent_body: The ride request, pricing and tracking screens are not built yet (items F2-02 to F2-12). Your consent really is recorded now, and no request screen waits behind it — we say so plainly instead of showing a button that leads nowhere.
welcome.error.session: Your session expired or was not accepted. Reopen the app from Telegram.
welcome.error.version_not_current: The copy your app is showing is out of date and the document has changed. Reopen the app to read the current version before accepting.
welcome.error.account_not_found: You do not have an account with us yet. Send /start to the bot first, then reopen the app.
welcome.error.unavailable: The consent service is unavailable right now. Nothing was recorded, and retrying is safe.
welcome.error.rejected: The consent was not accepted as sent. Try again, and if it repeats, reopen the app.

rider.account.debt.title: Not available on this screen yet:
rider.account.debt.editIdentity: Editing your name and phone — both come from Telegram at sign-in, and there is no path yet to change them here.
rider.account.debt.emergencyContact: Emergency contact — not built yet. We will not show a field that is filled in but never saved: a safety promise we cannot keep is worse than none.
rider.account.debt.notificationPrefs: Notification preferences — not built yet. Operational trip notifications reach you either way.
rider.account.rights.title: Your rights over your data
rider.account.export.note: We will download a file with everything we hold about you: your profile, trips, places, consents, ratings and reports. The file is saved on your device and we keep no copy of it.
rider.account.export.refusal.USER_NOT_FO: There is no data registered under your name yet.

rider.account.erasure.warning: Erasing your account cannot be undone. You will lose your trip history and saved places, and you will not be able to get them back.
rider.account.erasure.whatStays: Some things stay by rule: your consent stays as proof that we asked you, your rating of a driver stays because it is testimony about them and not about you, and support and safety reports stay because they may be disputed. After the erasure we will show you exactly what was removed, what stayed, and why.
rider.account.erasure.barStays: One last thing before you press: if your account is blocked, or you have ratings from your trips, the block and the rating are kept and applied to you again if you sign up later with the same Telegram account or the same phone number. We do not keep your name or your number for this — only an encrypted fingerprint that neither can be recovered from. The reason is simple: erasure is your right, but it is not a way out of a ban you earned or a rating others earned about you.
rider.account.erasure.alreadyErased: This account was already erased. The receipt is a record of the moment it happened, so we will not rebuild it from numbers that were never measured then.
rider.account.erasure.refusal.ACTIVE_ORD: You have {orders} trip(s) in progress. Finish or cancel them and come back — erasing now would leave a driver waiting with nothing.
rider.account.erasure.refusal.NOT_A_RIDE: This screen is for rider accounts. Driver account erasure has its own path, which is not open yet.
rider.account.erasure.refusal.USER_NOT_F: There is no account under your name to erase.
rider.account.erasure.refusal.INVALID_AC: We could not identify your account. Close the app and open it again.
rider.account.erasure.refusal.UNKNOWN: The erasure failed for a reason we cannot name yet. Contact support before trying again.
rider.account.receipt.total: {rows} records removed or stripped of your identity
rider.account.receipt.anonymized: Record kept, your identity removed from it
rider.account.basis.CONSENT_IS_COMPLIANC: Your consent is proof that we asked you; erasing it erases the proof.
rider.account.basis.RATING_IS_TESTIMONY_: Your rating is testimony about a driver; erasing it takes away a reputation they earned.
rider.account.basis.SUPPORT_RECORD_MAY_B: A support record may be disputed after erasure.
rider.account.basis.SAFETY_REPORT_MAY_BE: A safety report may be disputed, and may concern someone else's safety.
rider.account.basis.AUDIT_TRAIL_PROVES_T: The audit trail is itself the proof that this erasure happened.
rider.account.basis.BLOCK_AND_STANDING_S: Your block and your ratings stay even if you erase your account, so that erasure cannot be used to shed a ban or a bad rating and come back with a clean face.
rider.account.basis.UNKNOWN: A retention reason we cannot name yet.
